digest.component_or_area: test suite - subprocess and network timeout sentinels
propositions: Five real-subprocess reap tests burn ~1s wall-clock each waiting for a 1s timeout deadline to expire, creating unnecessary latency in test execution
A blanket autouse timeout fixture creates a latent load flake in the opposite direction for the 429-retry test, whose fake children must complete within the 1s window
Three reap tests' assertions on child-side setup completion depend implicitly on the injected window being larger than interpreter startup, creating a hidden race condition
The snapshot fetch stall test injects a 2s low-speed window when the sibling dribble test already proves git honors a 1s window, wasting test execution time
Test-only timeout values must be decoupled from production defaults (120s call / 3s grace / 2s drain) while ensuring child readiness is ordered explicitly rather than by timing assumptions
